title: fix(tooling): isolate the throwaway git repos in the merge driver and the pre-commit/pre-push gate
body:
Fixes #16753

Tier A of the #16644 class: the two files **git itself invokes** built throwaway git repositories with no environment of their own. `scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs` **is** the `merge=os-regen` driver, so git exports `GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE` / `GIT_INDEX_FILE` into it by construction; `scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs` is what `.githooks/pre-commit` and `.githooks/pre-push` invoke — the exact path #16624 travelled. Those variables outrank `cwd`, so a `git init` / `git config` / `git add` aimed at a temp directory lands on the real repository.

Tiers B and C stay on #16644. No repo-wide gate here — that belongs after Tier C.

## Per spawn site, classified rather than blanket-stripped

Acceptance item 4 asks for a local-only / network-touching call per site. **Neither file spawns a network child** — measured with a control: zero `fetch` / `clone` / `push` / `ls-remote` sites in these two files, non-zero in eight other files under `scripts/`. So "apply to every local-only site" would mean *all* of them, and that is wrong: three local-only sites read the ambient repository **on purpose**, and stripping them is a behaviour change in the dangerous direction. The table below is the confirmation the card asked the reviewer to produce.

### scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs

| spawn site | git command | subject | class | `gitFreeEnv()` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gitDir()` from `markPending` (driver path) | `rev-parse --absolute-git-dir` | the repository git is merging | ambient by design | no |
| `isProbeInvocation()` | `rev-parse --git-path index` | the index git holds right now | ambient by design | no |
| `textMergeInPlace()` | `merge-file` on the three `%O %A %B` temp paths | no repository at all | local-only, driver path | no |
| `reconcileUntrackedDispositions()` | `ls-files -- SPEC` | this checkout | local-only | yes |
| `reconcileAttributeSemantics()` | `ls-files -z` | this checkout | local-only | yes |
| `reconcileAttributeSemantics()` | `check-attr -z merge --stdin` | this checkout | local-only | yes |
| `hookIsExecutable()` | `ls-files -s .githooks/pre-commit` | this checkout's index | local-only | yes |
| `registeredDriverResolves()` | `config --get merge.os-regen.driver` | this clone's config | local-only | yes |
| `expandDriverScript()` | `sh -c` expanding `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` — **indirect** | this checkout | local-only | yes |
| `endToEnd()` | `init` `config` `add` `commit` `checkout` `merge` `status` | throwaway repo | local-only | yes |
| `endToEndMixed()` | the same set | throwaway repo | local-only | yes |
| `probeLeavesNoMarker()` | the same set, plus `gitDir(dir, gitFreeEnv())` | throwaway repo | local-only | yes |
| `probeLeavesNoMarker()` | `spawnSync merge-tree --write-tree` | throwaway repo | local-only | yes |

### scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs

| spawn site | git command | subject | class | `gitFreeEnv()` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gitDirPath()` | `rev-parse --absolute-git-dir` | the repository the hook is running in | ambient by design | no |
| `mergeInProgress()` | `rev-parse HEAD` | the merge being completed right now | ambient by design | no |
| `fixtureSelfTest()` | `init` `config` `add` `commit` `merge` `checkout` `ls-files` | throwaway fixture | local-only | yes |
| `fixtureSelfTest()` / `runHook()` | a **node** child that re-enters this file inside the fixture and spawns git children of its own | throwaway fixture | local-only | yes |
| `prePushIsArmedSelfTest()` | `ls-files -s .githooks/pre-push` | this checkout's index | local-only | yes |
| `runCheck()` | `execSync('pnpm -s GATE')` — not a git child; the production gate run against this checkout | ambient by design | no (unchanged) |

Why the three ambient sites must stay ambient, in one line each: `isProbeInvocation()` reads the lock on the index `GIT_INDEX_FILE` names — strip it and a **real merge** reads as a probe and the deferral's own record is dropped, which the file's own docblock already calls the asymmetric direction; `gitDir()` on the driver path would otherwise write the marker for whatever repository `cwd` happens to sit in; `merge-file` is a child of the merge git is already performing and reading no index, so `gitFreeEnv()` would only take that merge's configuration away from it.

## A thirteenth spawn site the card's probe could not see

#16753 counts **12** `git` spawn sites in `git-merge-regen.mjs`. There are **13**. `expandDriverScript()` spawns `sh -c` on a command string containing `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)`, so the `'git'` literal probe does not find it — the **same false-negative species** the card records for `git init`, one level further out. It was found by the new behavioural battery, not by reading: with the leak live, `registeredDriverResolves()` expanded the registered driver against the stand-in repository and reported *this* clone's driver as missing.

## Red before green, on a disposable stand-in

⛔ Run literally against a shared checkout, this card's own acceptance test **reproduces** #16624. Both legs therefore use a scratch repository created for the test and thrown away; what is under test is that an ambient `GIT_DIR` outranks `cwd`, and any real repository shows that.

Each file grows one self-test battery, `ambientGitEnvIsolation`, which builds the stand-in, points all three variables at it, and re-enters the file's **whole** `--self-test` under that environment. The stand-in must come back byte-identical in config, index, refs and HEAD. It carries a firing control first — a plain `git` child in an unrelated directory must answer with the stand-in's git dir — because "untouched" is also what an environment that never reached the child produces.

**RED, with the batteries in place and the spawn sites unfixed:**

```
git-merge-regen.mjs   -> exit 1
  stand-in .git/config BEFORE:  [user] email = stand-in@objectstack.invalid / name = os-regen stand-in
  stand-in .git/config AFTER:   [user] email = selftest@objectstack.ai / name = self-test
                                [merge "os-regen"] name = regenerate instead of text-merging
                                                   driver = node ".../scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs" %O %A %B %P

check-regen-pending.mjs -> exit 1
  stand-in .git/config AFTER:   [core] hooksPath = /dev/null
                                [user] email = fixture@objectstack.test / name = os-regen fixture
```

The second one is worth naming: the fixture writes `core.hooksPath = /dev/null` into the config, and on a shared clone that **disarms every git hook for every worktree** — a damage shape beside the `core.bare` flip #16624 measured.

**GREEN, after the fix:** both exit 0, `pnpm check:merge-driver` exit 0.

**Measured asymmetry, recorded because it decides the fingerprint:** with all three variables set, git resolves the work tree to the stand-in, so `git add -A` re-adds the stand-in's own files and the index comes back **unchanged** — `scripts/git-env.mjs` records the same thing. Under `GIT_DIR` alone the index moves too (measured here: the stand-in's tracked file dropped, the corpus file staged). The fingerprint is therefore config + index + refs + HEAD, so it reddens under either shape.

## Negative control

With the variables absent — ordinary CI and hand-run — both files behave exactly as they do today. Diffed against output captured before any edit, the **only** difference is the new battery's own line; every pre-existing case prints byte-identical text. The production hook paths (`node scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs` and `--pre-push`) still exit 0 with no marker, and this PR's own commit and push ran through `.githooks/pre-commit` and `.githooks/pre-push` executing the changed code.

## Gates

Derived from the actual changed set with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`; every derived command run, exit codes recorded. All green, including `check:merge-driver`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:entry-guard`. Three `packages/spec` gates first exited 1 naming their own unmet prerequisite (`packages/spec/dist` not built, `json-schema/` absent) — NOT MEASURED, not a verdict; after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` all three exit 0.

No changeset: nothing published moves. Measured — 70 workspace packages declare `files[]` and none can ship repo-root `scripts/`; the root manifest is private with no `files[]`.
